name: Cerot Watolna
source:
Her hair is arranged in two raised side tails, and she has a very flat physique. She's lively, unyielding, and full of curiosity. She is the first princess of the country of Watolna, and has been given the name "Scarlet Ball of Silver Thread" (銀糸の緋玉 / Ginshi no Hidama). As the name indicates, her long silver hair really stands out.

The country of Watolna was historically founded by those who made a living as bandits, and perhaps because of that blood relationship, she's talented in battle. To compensate for her small build, she specializes in long objects.
